| description = Easy. Flees. No AOE. <br> 

Myga has two spawn points. The first is near Karkona in the TOV scar, and the other is in the NE corner of the zone near the entrance to the wyvern caves.

The 15 mobs in the spawn cycle are:

[[Amcilla]],
[[Atpaev]],
[[Bufa]],
[[Crial]],
[[Gangel]],
[[Honvar]],
[[Linbrak]],
[[Makala]],
[[Nintal]],
[[Myga]],
[[Onava]],
[[Quoza]],
[[Sivar]],
[[Uiliak]],
[[Yal]].

Myga and the placeholders have a fairly large roaming path. The approximate paths they take are [https://wiki.project1999.com/File:Myga1.png Myga1] and [https://wiki.project1999.com/File:Myga2.png Myga2]
